$comment: Routing contract per reports/extensions-40/spec-routing-hooks.md: rules are declarative DATA. ids unique ^[a-z0-9-]{1,32}$, priority 0..100 (default 50), <= 512 rules. 0.0.0.0/0 is forbidden. Evaluation: user rules first, then extension rules by (priority DESC, installed_at ASC, id ASC), first match wins.
